relations.subject: Bhikkhu Anālayo
relations.evidence: he stayed on and studied with Bhikkhu Bodhi... Bhikkhu Bodhi has been Bhikkhu Anālayo's main mentor in the study of the Pāli discourses.

relations.subject: Bhikkhu Anālayo
relations.evidence: In 1995 he took pabbajja again under Balangoda Ananda Maitreya Thero.

relations.subject: Bhikkhu Anālayo
relations.evidence: He received his upasampada in 2007 in the Sri Lankan Shwegyin Nikaya... with Pemasiri Thera of Sumathipala Aranya as his ordination acariya.

relations.subject: Bhikkhu Anālayo
relations.evidence: The late Bhikkhu Kaṭukurunde Ñāṇananda has also been an important influence in his understanding of the Dhamma

relations.subject: Bhikkhu Anālayo
relations.evidence: Godwin Samararatne has been the most influential meditation teacher in his early practice life.

relations.subject: Bhikkhu Anālayo
relations.evidence: Bhikkhu Anālayo completed a PhD thesis on the Satipaṭṭhāna Sutta at the University of Peradeniya in 2000

relations.subject: Bhikkhu Anālayo
relations.evidence: This led to his undertaking a habilitation research at the University of Marburg, completed in 2007

relations.subject: Bhikkhu Anālayo
relations.role: professor of the Numata Centre for Buddhist Studies
relations.evidence: Bhikkhu Anālayo has retired from being a professor of the Numata Centre for Buddhist Studies at the University of Hamburg.

relations.subject: Bhikkhu Anālayo
relations.evidence: He is the co-founder of the Āgama Research Group

relations.subject: Bhikkhu Anālayo
relations.evidence: a resident scholar at the Barre Center for Buddhist Studies.
